Class BackendEvidence

java.lang.Object
backendTests.BackendEvidence
public final class BackendEvidence extends Object
Captures readable source-viewer screenshots from the delivered backend files. Original line numbers and wrapping remain explicit; this is evidence capture, not a fabricated editor image or an application test. Task 3.1 inventory comes from the actual entityClasses directory.
